code.description: Shown once. Type it on the terminal or scan the QR payload.

get.summary: Audit log, newest first (keyset paginated; filters by actor, action, entity and time)
One audit entry with before/after for the diff view
CSV export of the filtered log (at most 10000 rows; the export is itself audited)

post.summary: Terminal: redeem a code with a new Ed25519 key (request signed with that key)
Create a one-time code that enrolls one terminal into a branch (15 minutes)
Terminal: report health; the reply carries the device status and server time
Supervisor: unlock an operator PIN after 5 failed tries

put.summary: Set or change my operator PIN for the active business

post.summary: Terminal: unlock for one operator with their PIN (request signed by an active terminal)

patch.summary: Rename, move, suspend, reactivate, revoke or blacklist a terminal

get.summary: List items (keyset). ?include=children expands children in one batched query.

post.summary: Create an item with optional children

get.summary: Branches this caller may see (a branch-scoped member sees only their branches)

post.summary: Add a branch (store, warehouse or office)

get.summary: One branch (404 outside the caller's branch scope)

patch.summary: Change a branch, or archive / restore it (branches are never deleted)

get.summary: Stock locations of a branch (sales floor, back room, warehouse)

post.summary: Add a stock location to a branch

get.summary: Business profile: name and defaults (country, currency, time zone, tax region)

patch.summary: Change the business profile (fields present change; null clears a default)

post.summary: Invite a person by email to this business (72 h, emailed link)
Accept an invite as the signed-in, verified user whose email it was sent to
Revoke a pending invite (its link stops working)

patch.summary: Rename or re-kind a location, or archive / restore it

get.summary: Tenants the signed-in user is an active member of
Members with their role names and branch scope (one query, keyset paginated)

put.summary: Replace a member's roles and, optionally, branch scope

get.summary: Onboarding state and the saved wizard draft (owner only)

put.summary: Save the wizard draft (owner only; save on step change, not per keystroke)

post.summary: Finish onboarding once the profile is complete (owner only, idempotent)

get.summary: Roles of this business with their grants (one query)

post.summary: Create a custom role (no grants yet)

put.summary: Replace a role's grants (takes effect on the next request)

post.summary: Make a tenant the active one for this session (404 unless an active member)
Create a business (tenant, roles, first branch, owner membership) and make it the active tenant
